name: Shaaraim
overview: Shaaraim, also called Sharaim, is identified in Scripture as a city within the territories of both Judah and Simeon, highlighting its significance in the tribal allotments of Israel. Joshua 15:36 lists Sharaim among the cities of Judah, while 1 Chronicles 4:31 references Shaaraim as one of the cities belonging to Simeon during the reign of David. Additionally, 1 Samuel 17:52 mentions Shaaraim in the context of the battle against the Philistines, indicating its geographical relevance near the gates of Ekron and Gath. These references collectively underscore Shaaraim's role in Israel's historical and tribal landscape.
